classification.difficultyReason: Follow the supplied angle-sum checkpoint before a single sine-rule distance.

content.prompt:
Andrew plans to build a triangular flower bed in the lower part of a circular garden.
The length of $TS$ is $24\text{m}$, $\angle TSR$ is $45^\circ$ and $\angle RTS$ is $40^\circ$.

spec.description: Dark blue circle with muted blue fill outside the white inscribed triangle TSR. T is at the left, S slightly lower at the right, and R at the bottom. TS carries 24 m above its midpoint. Interior arcs mark 40 degrees at T and 45 degrees at S. Point labels are outside the circle. No centre label or dot.
spec.mathematics: TS=24 m; angle RTS=40 degrees; angle TSR=45 degrees. Polar positions T=180 degrees, S=350 degrees and R=270 degrees reproduce both inscribed angles.

children.label: a
children.prompt: What is the size of $\angle SRT$?

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\angle SRT&=180^\circ-45^\circ-40^\circ\\&=95^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angles in a triangle sum to $180^\circ$.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Find the length of $TR$. Answer correct to the nearest metre.
